name: Stride Basics Mesh Runner
description: A no-frills breathable mesh trainer in grey, white, or black. Lightweight knit upper, foam midsole, rubber outsole with basic tread. The kind of shoe that gets worn to work, to the market, and to bed when you're too tired to take them off.
functionality: Minimal cushion-adjust dial at heel — three settings. Otherwise purely mechanical.
what_it_says: You buy what works. No frills, no statement.
story_hooks: The cushion dial is stuck on max — the previous owner glued it there after a knee injury.
A pair of these found at a crime scene are the only lead connecting a witness to the wrong neighborhood.
